title: Rosava River
summary: The Rosava is a river situated [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], recognized as a left-bank tributary of the Ros River. It spans 90 kilometers and serves a basin area of 1,720 square kilometers.

sections.heading: Geographical Information
paragraphs: The Rosava River is located in the [[dnieper|Dnieper]] Upland region of [[ukraine|Ukraine]]. It has a total length of 90 kilometers and drains a basin area of 1,720 square kilometers.

sections.heading: Administrative Regions
paragraphs: The river flows through two administrative [[administrative-territorial-entity-of-ukraine|regions of Ukraine]]: [[kyiv-oblast|Kyiv Oblast]] and [[cherkasy-oblast|Cherkasy Oblast]].

sections.heading: Settlements Along the River
paragraphs: The Rosava River is associated with several cities and towns, notably Kaharlyk and Myronivka, which are situated along its banks.
